ABUTRON RC1-08 v1.0.2 INSTALL / REPAIR SUMMARY
1. Verify current Jarvis health, Hermes, MT5 terminal, Abutron Core on 127.0.0.1:8088, and MT5 Bridge on 127.0.0.1:8090.
2. Run PowerShell as Administrator.
3. Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process Bypass -Force
4. New installation: run .\scripts\Install-RC1-08.ps1, then .\scripts\Test-RC1-08.ps1.
5. Existing v1.0.0/v1.0.1 installation: run .\scripts\Repair-RC1-08-v1.0.2.ps1.
6. The v1.0.2 repair validates Prometheus config, performs a clean scheduled-task restart, verifies the live process config path, and waits up to 90 seconds for the jarvis_rc1_08 target to become UP.
7. The v1.0.2 service reconciles legacy PENDING approvals whose incidents are already RECOVERED.
8. The repair then provisions/restarts Grafana and performs final incident/approval gates.
9. Perform controlled failure tests one component at a time. Keep execution disabled while testing.
10. Reboot Windows and repeat Test-RC1-08.ps1.
11. Sign RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md only after every gate passes.

EXISTING INSTALLATION COMMAND
  .\scripts\Repair-RC1-08-v1.0.2.ps1
